notes: VaultToken (src/VaultToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.2.0: name vault, symbol VAULT, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 VAULT (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which is the factory. There is no owner, minter, burner, pauser, blacklist, tax, rebase, upgrade path, proxy or initialization step, and the supply cannot change after construction. Transfers move exactly the amount requested, so no launch address needs an exemption. The launch deploys no application contracts and makes no initialization calls. The factory takes the swarm's share, seeds the single-sided ETH pool from economics.poolBps of the supply at the price it derives from economics.initialMarketCapWei, and forwards the remainder to economics.remainderTo.
